name: hud_ui_meter_constructor_ex
description: HudUiMeter::ConstructorEx builds the HudUiBar base, installs the extended meter ftable, and resets the meter fill and flag state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this extended HUD meter constructor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD bar/meter source-cluster pass.

The native bar/meter constructor smoke directly calls HudUiMeter::ConstructorEx on pre-seeded storage and verifies the returned self pointer, base bar construction, invalidation-mask propagation, cleared point storage, drawVertexCount=0, fillPixelsMax=0, and meterFlags=0 while preserving HudUiMeter placement-new constructor coverage.
